about: Openly licensed pairs from Wikimedia Commons, NASA's media library, the National Park Service and Blender's download server (public domain, CC0, CC BY). 'own': the edit was cut from this raw footage. 'different': the raw is other recordings. Files are saved under neutral names (reference, raw-1 …) so no file name carries a hint. Labels are written by the developer from the frames, so these pairs are always 'open', never blind.
